messages.subject: weibull_cdf error
parts: It seems that weibull_cdf(0, 1.4, 30) does not yield zero. I was expecting to get zero when evaluating the cdf at zero.

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: weibull_cdf error
parts:
That's strange. Can you share a reproducible example? I'm not seeing this behavior (i.e. I do get zero). And can you trying putting this  

print("This should be zero: ", weibull_cdf(0 , 1.4, 30));

in the model block of a Stan program and see what gets printed out? I just did that and it printed a zero at every iteration as expected. 

Jonah
